prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a low-speed head-on collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1059; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Front bumper cover cracked across the center with the reinforcement bar bent at the left mounting point, and the left headlamp assembly broken at its housing. The hood shows a shallow crease that lines up with the bumper damage, and the radiator support has minor bending on the same side. The pattern of damage is consistent with the frontal impact reported. Repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover, reinforcement bar, and headlamp, with straightening of the radiator support and refinishing of the hood. Labor hours are in line with the work described. The invoices show no duplicated charges. Nothing in the records points to earlier damage to this vehicle.
